FEAT-5-S117.title: Validation Error Handling and User-Safe Responses
FEAT-5-S117.description: Implement standardized handling for Pydantic validation failures and malformed tool inputs, ensuring errors are captured, sanitized, and returned as safe, user-readable responses without exposing internal schemas.

FEAT-5-S118.title: Allowlist Enforcement and Unknown Tool Rejection
FEAT-5-S118.description: Ensure strict allowlist enforcement by rejecting any tool calls not explicitly registered, including logging of rejected attempts and preventing execution of non-allowlisted tools.

FEAT-5-S119.title: Tool Execution Logging and Debug Trace Integration
FEAT-5-S119.description: Integrate tool routing with debug logging to capture tool selection, input payloads (de-identified where required), execution timing, and outcomes for traceability and QA analysis.
